name: Explore Tuyo Card
summary: Learn about the Tuyo Visa card — pay with USDC worldwide and use Apple Pay

steps.title: Home screen
steps.description: Main dashboard showing Total balance $0.00, quick action buttons (Add money, Send, Convert), yield promo card, and bottom tab bar.

steps.title: Tuyo Card — USDC payments
steps.action: Tap Card tab (3rd in bottom bar)
steps.description: Tuyo Visa card preview (ending 6321) with USDC logo. 'Pay with USDC, anywhere in the world' — use USDC in your Tuyo account to pay in 40 million merchants worldwide. Green 'Get Tuyo Card for free' CTA. Carousel page indicator (2 pages).
steps.changes: Tab switched to Card. Card tab highlighted in bottom bar.

steps.title: Tuyo Card — Apple Pay
steps.description: Second carousel page showing iPhone with Tuyo card in Apple Wallet at a payment terminal. 'Spend in-store with Apple Pay' — add Tuyo Card to Apple Wallet and tap phone to pay. Same 'Get Tuyo Card for free' CTA.
